purpose: Per Section 7, forensically reconcile all 31 credit-neutral disagreements from Phase 3F.1.5.1 BEFORE any matching-logic remediation. Classification taxonomy: A=FALSE_SAFE_SURFACING, B=VALID_SAFE_SURFACING_WRONG_LABEL, C=REVIEWER_ERROR, D=GT_AMBIGUITY, E=EVALUATOR_AMBIGUITY, F=OTHER.
methodology: For each case, identified the specific candidate(s) V2 relied on to justify its safe/no-credit disposition (matchedCandidateIds, or the SAFETY_FLAG/INVENTORY_ONLY/HONEST_UNRESOLVED-tagged candidates the reason text names), then cross-referenced the SAME candidate ID against the second-pass reviewer independent per-candidate correspondence judgment (YES/PARTIAL/NO) for that exact candidate. If V2 relied exclusively on candidate(s) the reviewer judged NO correspondence for, classified FALSE_SAFE_SURFACING (A). If ANY relied-upon candidate the reviewer judged YES/PARTIAL, classified VALID_SAFE_SURFACING_WRONG_LABEL (B) - genuine correspondence exists per an independent reader; the disagreement is a labeling nuance, not a false flag.
notAllAssumedErrors: Per Section 7 explicit instruction (do not assume all 31 are V2 errors simply because the reviewer disagreed), 4 of 31 cases (13%) were independently verified as cases where genuine correspondence DOES exist (the reviewer itself judged YES/PARTIAL on the relied-upon candidate) - these are legitimate labeling disagreements (e.g. AMBIGUOUS vs REVIEW_REQUIRED_FLAG_ONLY; UNREPRESENTED vs DISCOVERY_ONLY_NOT_REPRESENTED for the discovery-vs-representation distinction, which is working AS INTENDED per Phase 3F.1.5.1s own false-credit-protection finding), not evaluator defects.
rootCauseHypothesisFormedFromThisData: See 02-safe-surfacing-correspondence-spec.json and 03-definition-overmatch-root-cause.json - both derived FROM this forensic data, not the reverse.
